positions.title: Student Strategy Consultant
positions.description:
Pina (YC) is a Munich Startup protecting forests by quantifying and rewarding sustainable forestry, currently active in Germany. 
In a group of three CDTM students we 
• identified geographical and technological follow-on markets, 
• analyzed and quantified the market potential of those, and 
• developed a go-to-market strategy for the most promising market. 
Learnings include:
• analytic and structured working, market research, presenting and client communication, paired with a 
• thorough understanding of voluntary carbon credit markets and 
• carbon sequestration and measurement techniques.

positions.title: Student Product Developer
positions.description:
As part of Forto’s sustainability strategy, we were tasked to identify and develop a viable product to reduce the environmental impact of global logistics within a team of five CDTM students. The developed solution, an API automatically calculation and enabling compensation of CO2 emissions, served as concept and was integrated in a similar way into Forto's product.
• Analysed the drivers of global logistic's huge climate effect and identified technologically and economically feasible solutions.
• Conceptualized and developed an API enabling automated calculation and compensation of CO2 emissions that is embeddable in any website. This product realizes the three-stage strategy identified to overcome the drivers of pollution: Create awareness for the problem, Educate quantitatively about individual GHG emissions, and Enable mitigating action.
Learnings include:
• Methodologically on product development: problem analysis through user interviews, prototyping, market and competitor analysis, financial modeling, investor presentation, and pitch deck creation.
• Content-related on sustainability: Emissions factors in logistics, voluntary carbon markets, (lack of practical) technological abatement options in global logistics, positioning and communication of sustainability/CSR-efforts.

positions.title: Project Intern - Maintenance Digitalization
positions.description:
Project Intern tasked with identifying and developing concepts for optimizing aircraft maintenance through augmented reality in a team of two project interns. Additionally developed legally viable integrations of each concept into current maintenance processes and proposed a digital-twin-based digitalization strategy for maintenance processes. 
The recommended solution was awarded with an internal, Lufthansa Group-wide innovation award and is being implemented.
• Analyzed aircraft maintenance processes, identified improvement opportunities, researched technological solutions.
• Developed various concepts for improving aircraft maintenance through deployment of augmented reality solutions including adjustment of respective current processes.
• Ensured legal conformity of proposed solutions (esp. process adjustments) with requirements by the Luftfahrtbundesamt.
• Validated each concept with technology suppliers (on site feasibility validation), maintenance experts (process validation), and IT-personell (implementability validation).
• Performed joint data analysis of flight and maintenance data using Python for business case evaluation.
• Pitched concrete recommendation especially considering the economic impact and technological limitations to senior maintenance management of Lufthansa Group airlines.

company.name: Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
company.description:
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we work closely with clients to embrace a transformational approach aimed at benefiting all stakeholders—empowering organizations to grow, build sustainable competitive advantage, and drive positive societal impact.
 
Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives that question the status quo and spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting, technology and design, and corporate and digital ventures. 

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, fueled by the goal of helping our clients thrive and enabling them to make the world a better place.
